rechecks.verdict: Ready to show Tamsin. Every first-review blocker and major in the requirements and hidden-information lenses is fixed, and I checked each fix against the renders, the source and every line of bar_texts.txt. No unrevealed row is named on the board or in any bar text; the one EN02 'opens Computing' entry is never printed. No odds, windows or tiers appear on revealed rows. FTL appears only as the tag, its line and the button. QP09 and QP10 are shown identically, with no rival or exclusivity hint. Prices include the TH15 multiplier. The description pane never overflows, on any of the roughly 290 selections per turn, on desktop or phone. What remains are 12 minors. Two are new problems in states reached by clicking Stop or 'Fund Quantum Physics' on the Endeavour artboards: the queue rule and the set-aside bar contradict the shown state. The others are wording and consistency errors: 'ahead of its time' on current-era rows at turn 231, the FTL tag on MA13, the key's 'Dead end' and 'Rival' definitions, the key naming the real Unique Megalithic Observatory, 683 + 171 ≠ 853, and O07 claiming to open Medicine. Three first-round minors are still open: Calculus missing from the modifiers, 'Explosives (non-gunpowder)', and the nested needs grouping. None of these blocks a showing.

rechecks.verdict: Nearly ready, with one major left. Every blocker from the first review is fixed. I clicked through every flow on desktop and phone with no page error and no blank screen: fund, right-click queue and unqueue, move in the queue, every filter including a disabled one, collapsing sections and bands, the focus view and back, chips of every status, Begin, Replace, Stop, Resume, the switch-away popup, Experiment and Synthesis. Nearly all the first-round majors in this lens are fixed too. The bar no longer overflows for any default selection (0 of 284 and 0 of 286 on desktop; no description overflow on phone). The badge and queue marks are distinct, the Endeavour glyph is distinct, the Stop target is right, and Experiment and Synthesis work. The remaining major is that Replace (and Begin while an Endeavour is set aside) throws away the old Endeavour's progress, although its popup says it can be resumed, against tech_tree.md l.195. The minors are mostly state-coherence edges (the set-aside figure and its description, funding an empty focus, filters hiding the Endeavour or emptying the focus view, a stale Synthesis line, the Electricity focus text, a stale 'Fund Optics' button, dead Close and Faster-than-light buttons, no keyboard handling in popups) and a few visual regressions (12-px text in the Endeavour pill, phone action-button labels spilling out of their pills, the clipped phone focus-view header, an 18-px clip when certain foci are moved to next in the queue). Outside this lens I noticed that format major 1, the static style holes, is still open. The scripts and renders are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Uncharted-Horizons/ffab2c8f-97b2-5cca-83ad-f0d7b939b828/scratchpad/rc/.

resolved: Format major, 'the view Tweak does nothing': resolved. componentDidUpdate(prev) now compares prev.view and phone and re-runs initState. I checked it in the canvas's own dc-runtime.js, which is byte-identical to the published artifact-type/dc-runtime.js. The runtime passes the host's previous props, and these carry view and phone as top-level keys. Calling __dcSetProps on Main switched it correctly to t231-endeavour, t226-focus-energy, t231-switch-away (the popup opens), phone on and off (1300×600 and back to 1440×810) and t226-whole-board (1440×2040).
